thread:
Maria Gomez: Quick check: cutting release tonight — docs/site regen + SDK docs needs to land before branch freeze. Planning freeze at 17:00 PT. Who can own SDK regen + changelog bump? Also we need a rollback plan for docs site if the new fragments break the site.
Aj Patel: I can take SDK regen. Will run regen on staging and smoke. ETA 60m. What's the markdown changelog entry? breaking? or minor?
Maria Gomez: It's a minor version bump (1.3.4 -> 1.4.0) with a small API param rename (non-breaking for most but we should call it out). Put it under 'Docs: param rename and SDK sync' — Sanjay will confirm wording.
Sanjay Rao: I'll draft the changelog line. Quick question: do we pin the console example snippets to the new SDK patch? We should add snippet versions to avoid mismatch.
Katie Lin: Agree on pinning. I can add snippet tags in the console docs. Also schedule: regen needs to finish by 16:00 PT to allow docs build + smoke.
Leo Zhang: Heads up: docsite deploy is on the same nodepool as console canary. If the new build fails, we need a fast rollback. Recommend keeping previous build tarball in /srv/artifacts/docs-prev.tar.gz and a one-liner to restore.
Maria Gomez: Good idea. Can someone add that restore command to the runbook? Example: `tar -xzf /srv/artifacts/docs-prev.tar.gz -C /var/www/html && systemctl restart nginx`
Aj Patel: I'll add the runbook snippet and kick off the regen in ~5m. I'll tag the PR with `docs/sdk-regenerate-1.4.0` and request review from @Katie and @Sanjay.
deploy-bot: docs-deploy: build queued for staging (build #5421). Watch: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/5421
Katie Lin: I'll review the SDK snippets once PR is up. Quick note: we'll need a small highlight in the console release notes for 'example payload update' — add to the changelog under 'Console docs'.
Sanjay Rao: Changelog draft: 'Docs/SDK: parameter name clarified (old: user_id, new: subject_id); examples updated for SDK 1.4.0. No behavior change.' Will push to CHANGELOG.md now.
deploy-bot: docs-deploy: staging build #5421 succeeded. Preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/preview/5421
Maria Gomez: Awesome. Aj please run smoke: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/ -I` — if 200, we promote. Target promotion window 16:30 PT.
Aj Patel: Smoke done: 200 OK. Found one snippet mismatch in /guides/console — fixed and force-pushed. PR updated.
Katie Lin: :thumbsup: I'm good with promotion after CI passes. I'll cut the changelog release note and add the console snippet pin.
Maria Gomez: Ok rolling promotion at 16:35 PT. If anything fails we'll rollback with the tarball. Thanks team.
